items.q: and so I was up there one time, and Bukowski was up there reading his stuff.

ctx.x: He went away for a long time, you know. But he - So I’ve performed with these ­ So they come down and take me up to Santa Cruz, Charles Bukowski and stuff. And so they’d be up in Santa Cruz, and so I was up there one time, and Bukowski was up there reading his stuff. And this beautiful - this is why you have to he careful about gold and women - this beautiful girl had... what do you call it? Mountains and headlights for days. And equipment, lower body theory, all that stuff. So she took off her clothes and she…
Well being from San Pedro I know about Bukowski.
